records.tagline: Secure decentralized messaging without tracking
records.description: Mefesio is an advanced decentralized messaging app built for stronger security, privacy, and safety.Unlike traditional apps, Mefesio is fully decentralized and end-to-end encrypted on your device — no central servers, no tracking, no data collection. It doesn’t store your IP address, location, contacts, or activity.Extra safety layer: it automatically blocks profane content and dangerous links, making it the safest choice for families, kids, and professionals.Your messages. Your control.

records.name: SnapPose
records.tagline: Perfect place, no pose idea? Get inspired fast
records.description: SnapPose helps you find the perfect pose for any location in seconds. Whether you're at a café, beach, or traveling solo, just pick a vibe and get pose ideas instantly — no more awkward photos or wasted time scrolling.

records.name: driveTree
records.tagline: Turn any Google Drive folder into a GitHub-style view
records.description: Paste any public Google Drive folder link and get a GitHub-style file tree with syntax highlighting, one-click downloads, ZIP export, and shareable permalinks. No sign-up, no install, no tracking. Free and open source (GPL v3), self-hostable.

records.name: ExecMentor
records.tagline: AIpowered meeting prep for execs who can't afford to wing it
records.description: Ever walked into a high-stakes meeting and wished you had a coach in your corner? That's ExecMentor. Tell us who you're meeting, what's at stake, and we'll generate a strategic briefing with talking points tailored to stakeholders' decision style, intelligence researched, and political navigation advice for tricky power dynamics. Watch-outs so nothing blindsides you, then practice the conversation, pushing back where they would, and helping you sharpen your pitch before it counts.

records.name: Meal Ai
records.tagline: AI meal planner that learns your goals & allergies
records.description: Stop wasting time on meal planning. Meal AI generates personalized recipes in seconds based on your calorie goals, allergies, dietary preferences, and what's in your fridge. Log meals with photos, track macros, get AI coaching, and build smart grocery lists—all powered by AI trained on 1,000,000+ meal combinations. The Cal AI alternative your wallet can afford.

records.name: Outlai - Stop guessing where your $ goes
records.tagline: AI expense tracker — just type it, we log it
records.description: Outlai is an AI-powered expense tracker where you type expenses naturally — "coffee $5, lunch $12" — and AI logs, categorizes, and tracks them instantly. 150+ currencies supported. Built for people who quit every other budgeting app.

records.name: WebOwnr
records.tagline: sell more and grow with confidence
records.description: Grow your ecommerce revenue with AI-powered tools built for Nigerian businesses. Attract more traffic, convert more visitors, and manage daily operations with less stress.

records.name: Cover My Assets
records.tagline: Privacy & legal complaince tools for adult creators
records.description: Privacy isn't a feature here; it's the architecture. Keeping a creator's information private is a direct safety measure in this industry. We are the only platform combining DMCA takedowns, federal 2257 compliance, anonymous LLC formation, and protective contracts with e-signatures in one place. Everything is automated so creators can manage their own business without a predatory agency or manager. Built by a woman with a CS and legal background. Starting at $49/month and infinitely scalable.

records.name: Linkedin Profile Hunter
records.tagline: Your fastest way to source talent & Leads from LinkedIn
records.description: LinkedIn Profile Hunter is a Chrome extension built for recruiters, founders, and growth teams to quickly extract LinkedIn profile data. Export leads, build talent pipelines, and find crypto/Web3 candidates in seconds. No manual copy-paste. No wasted time. Perfect for outbound hiring, lead generation, and scaling recruitment workflows.

records.name: Scriva
records.tagline: Generate high-converting YouTube scripts in seconds.
records.description: Generate high-converting YouTube scripts, TikTok hooks, VSL copy, and ad scripts in seconds. Powered by GPT-4.1 and o3. Used by 1,000+ creators and agencies.

records.name: UpLyf
records.tagline: AI that reads your voice to understand how you really feel
records.description: Stop rating your mood 1-10. Uplyf actually figures out how you're doing by listening to your voice tone, pace, and pauses. Talk to Bloom, your AI companion who gets it. Journal with real-time transcription. Match anonymously with real people who actually open up because there are no names or profiles. Meditate. Get weekly deep insights about your patterns. Free tier available, no credit card. Built for Gen-Z by someone who needed this app first. Questions? Reach us at uplyf.app/contact

records.name: Mailero
records.tagline: Turn support emails into tickets
records.description: Most helpdesks are overkill. Mailero lets you manage customer support directly from email — just forward your inbox and start replying to tickets instantly. No setup, no complex workflows, no bloated features. Built for solo founders who want fast, simple support. EU hosted and GDPR compliant.

records.name: Amanda AI 2.0
records.tagline: Multi-Engine Architecture. Zero Data Retention. DeepThink.
records.description: Amanda 2.0 is the proprietary AI core by ThirdRez Labs. Multi-engine neural architecture with ~200B+ parameters, DeepThink chain-of-thought reasoning, adaptive personas, zero-censorship design, and full client-side privacy. Free to use.

records.name: MoltIn - LinkedIn for AI Agents
records.tagline: Your personal agent to network, get suppliers, find work.
records.description: MoltIn is designed to be a “hybrid” LinkedIn, where everyone can have a digital professional avatar that is networking for them 24/7. The Avatar or “Agent” has context of the users’ professional life, users can see what their agent is doing via Telegram and prompt accordingly if needed. Each users’ Avatar or “Digital Coworker” finds potential customers, applies for jobs, finds investors, and builds agentic social capital.

records.name: Mira AI Systems
records.tagline: Compliance-first AI for Realtors Pros, built by a lic NC pro
records.description: Mira AI Systems is the only AI platform built by a practicing, dual-licensed North Carolina Realtor and Mortgage Loan Originator. Generate NCREC & Fair Housing-safe MLS descriptions, social media posts, instant marketing kits, buyer financing snapshots, and more — all in seconds. • MLS Description Optimizer with built-in Compliance Center • Instant Listing Marketing Kit (social posts, emails) • Buyer Financing Snapshots & plain-language explainers • Real-time Fair Housing & NCREC risk scanning

records.name: Bloom
records.tagline: AI emotional support for IVF patients, 24/7
records.description: IVF is brutal. The 2am anxiety. The two-week wait. Failed cycles. Feeling completely alone. Bloom was built for those moments. A free AI companion that actually listens — no medical advice, no "stay positive", just someone who gets it. Real-time chat, guided breathing, daily affirmations and private journaling — all free, no signup. Already helping patients in Australia, USA, Ireland, India and Pakistan. Built by a 19-year-old healthcare student. On a phone.

records.name: EzDeploy
records.tagline: Simplify you ML & LLM Deployments
records.description: Deploy your machine learning models to any platform with one click. AI-powered DevOps orchestration that auto-detects your framework and generates production-ready Dockerfiles. Built by Oryvo AI.

records.name: Ziyuf Al Rahman Umrah Packages from UK
records.tagline: We’ve helped over 1,000 UK pilgrims book Umrah packages UK
records.description: Booking Umrah Packages is not just about finding a date and a fare. It is about knowing what you are paying for, who is handling your visa, and whether the person on the phone will still answer once the booking is confirmed. Discover your perfect Umrah Packages from UK. ATOL protected and all-inclusive deals with direct flights, visa, transfers & hotels. Book your Umrah journey today with Ziyuf Al Rahman.

records.name: VibeCEO
records.tagline: Consult 15 Global Icons and Business Legends 24/7
records.description: Get personalized business advice from the world's most successful CEOs through our AI-powered advisory platform. Learn from leaders like Steve Jobs, Jeff Bezos, and more.

records.name: PictionaryWords
records.tagline: Free Pictionary word generator for any group
records.description: Free Pictionary word generator with smart filters. 🎯 Difficulty levels — easy, medium, hard 👶 Kids mode (ages 4-12) 🎉 Adults mode 📂 12+ categories — animals, movies, food, sports 🖨️ Print-ready cards 📺 Fullscreen mode for group play 🇪🇸 Spanish/English bilingual mode 🎄 Holiday themes — Christmas, Halloween No signup. No ads. 1,250+ curated words. Works on any device. Just open and play.
